literal: "You can't do much of anything like this!\\r\\n"
"$n swoops down, narrowly missing your face."
"There is no such rank in the clan.\\r\\n"
"You are too stupid to communicate with language!\\r\\n"
"The portal begins to rise, lifted by the air elemental summoned by your rune!\\n\\r\\n\\r"
"$n tries to break your neck, but can't!"
"$n drives $p into your chest with a solid blow!"
"$n junks $p. It vanishes in a puff of smoke!"
"That doesn't make much sense, now does it?\\r\\n"
"Your magickal center is already tattooed. Get a new arm or get rid of that tattoo then come back."
"You can't seem to figure out how to use it.\\r\\nTry holding it.(?)\\r\\n"
"How can you think of food at a time like this?!?\\r\\n"
"You savagely rip into $p, feeding your insatiable appetite."
"The sleeping body of $n fades from existence."
"Flag must be ALL, SELECT, or NEW.\\r\\n"
"$n says, 'Ok $N, I'll let ya off this time, but don't do it again'."
"$n deftly disarms you, knocking $p from your hand!"
"You try to think aloud, but cannot!\\r\\n"
"You are outside.. where do you want to go?\\r\\n"
"You beat yourself about the face and neck."
"You are mortally wounded, and will die soon, if not aided.\\r\\n"
"$n curses as $e bends some of $s lockpicks."
"Nah, you're too much of a badass to go in there!\\r\\n"
"$n growls, 'So, you have found my lair...'"
"With a dazzling show of swordplay, you attempt to parry...but are outmaneuvered!\\r\\n"
"You've already reached the maximum number of guests in your house!\\r\\n"
"You are already learned in that area."
"Some kind of %s streaks in from %s and strikes $n!"
"$n gets knocked off of his mount."
"$n falls to $s knees, clutching $s groin and throwing up\\r\\neverywhere!"
"How do you expect to stable a mount, you don't have a mount!"
"A strong force jolts $n in $s attempt to leave south."
"You can't remove $p, it must be CURSED!"
"\\r\\nWith a blinding flash of light and a crack of thunder, $n appears!\\r\\n\\r\\n"
